overview_description.description:
IcePanel is a SaaS tool for tech teams to collaborate on their software architecture design.

We take a lightweight visual approach to modelling, linked with resources in the real world, designed for technical and non-technical people.

about_short_description.short_description: IcePanel is a SaaS tool for tech teams to collaborate on their software architecture design.

product.name: IcePanel SaaS Platform
product.description: A cloud-based software tool for collaborative software architecture modeling using the C4 model, enabling teams to design, document, and communicate complex system architectures.

product.name: Flows Feature
product.description: A tool within IcePanel to overlay and visualize sequences of messages and user/business flows on existing architecture diagrams.

product.name: Version Control and Drafts
product.description: Functionality to manage versions of architecture models and design future states in isolation before merging changes into the current model.

product.name: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) Integration
product.description: A feature to document and store significant architectural decisions within IcePanel and synchronize them with external git repositories.

product.name: Dynamic Views and Visual Overlays
product.description: Capability to view architecture models from multiple perspectives by overlaying metadata, tags, and message flows on existing diagrams.

product.name: Collaboration and Feedback Tools
product.description: Features that allow team members and stakeholders to comment, annotate, and provide feedback on architecture diagrams and models within IcePanel.
